Steering ($\beta$\,=\,5) recovers GAR to 0.727, confirming attention misallocation as the proximal cause. Scheduled sampling compresses the gap from 8$\times$ to 1.4$\times$ with no perplexity cost (two seeds, mean GAR\,=\,0.383)---the first evidence that this RNN-era technique transfers to multi-turn transformer attention objectives.
